en: The image shows a historical city gate made of brick, with round towers on both sides and a central arched entrance. The structure appears medieval, with a pointed roof and a small turret. Several people are visible around and under the gate, and a man is seen leaning on a cart in the foreground. The postcard caption at the top reads 'Bruges — La porte des Maréchaux.' Trees are framing the scene, and cobbled streets lead up to the gate.
